prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preview Companion Personalities", "Select key personality traits to see how your desktop pet will react during daily work.", "Playful vs Calm Companion", "Continue to Path Selection"]
1: ["Design Your Desktop Companion", "Choose your primary pet archetype and visual style to begin customization.", "Select Companion Archetype", "Instant Desktop Sync Included"]
2: ["Master Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to easily summon, move, or hide your companion from your system taskbar.", "Press Alt+P to toggle pet visibility", "Got It, Start Playing"]
3: []
4: ["Building Your Desktop Pet's World", "Setting up animations, behaviors, and interactive desktop desktop docking.", "Constructing pet memory index..."]
5: ["Ensure single subject, clear face lighting, and high contrast for best rendering results.", "Frontal lighting, clear view of eyes, neutral background"]
6: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to access companion settings or pause movement.", "Tray Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+P"]
7: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Journey", "Pick Instant Adopt for pre-built species, or Custom Creator to model a companion from your own pet photos.", "You can add more pets later from your desktop dashboard."]
8: ["Save Your Companion to Cloud", "Create an account to protect your pet's memory, sync across devices, and unlock the Starter Accessory Pack.", "Your pet progress is instantly backed up safely.", "Includes Free Companion Collar & Cloud Backup"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to finalize their birth registration.", "Pet Name", "Certified Desktop Companion"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and unlocked gifts (Starter Accessory Pack, Free Companion Collar).
